description: Verify actual sampling gaps against the expected 10–15 minute interval; flag missing/late data and compute basic uptime metrics.

result_summary.name: total_readings
result_summary.description: Total number of valid sensor rows.

result_summary.name: on_time_gaps
result_summary.description: Count of gaps within expected 10–15 minutes.

result_summary.name: early_gaps
result_summary.description: Count of gaps shorter than 10 minutes.

result_summary.name: late_gaps
result_summary.description: Count of gaps longer than 15 minutes.

result_summary.name: nonpositive_gaps
result_summary.description: Count of non-positive/undefined gaps (includes first row).

result_summary.name: estimated_missing_samples
result_summary.description: Estimated missing readings inferred from long gaps.

result_summary.name: uptime_pct_gap_based
result_summary.description: Uptime percentage based on gaps-derived missing samples.

result_summary.name: uptime_pct_span_based
result_summary.description: Uptime percentage based on coverage over total time span.
